F00.rollback: No feature enabled; no changes to weights or saved profile.

F10.title: Async gateway
F10.rollback: Disable platform routes; retain legacy chat/admin routes and stored data.

F12.title: CLI integration
F12.rollback: Disable opt-in commands; retain existing installer/run/chat commands.

F13.title: Multi-agent
F13.rollback: Disable child creation, cancel/drain children; preserve parent receipts.

F14.rollback: Disable private ingestion/search; retain encrypted-at-rest storage policy and ACLs.

F16.title: Memory context
F16.rollback: Disable new context assembly; existing PersonalStore/summaries remain unchanged.

F17.title: Plugin manifests

F18.rollback: Stop workers; revoke activation; never fall back to in-host import.

F19.title: Skill packages
F19.rollback: Disable package layer; retain existing built-in validated skills.

F20.title: Scheduler
F20.rollback: Pause all jobs; fence leases and revoke standing grants; do not rerun missed writes.

F21.title: Outbox
F21.rollback: Pause deliveries; mark uncertain sends for reconciliation; do not blindly retry.

F22.title: Channel interface
F22.rollback: Disable channel ingress, revoke pairings/worker credentials; retain receipts.

F23.title: Telegram subset
F23.rollback: Disable Telegram ingress/outbox and revoke bot connection; retain dedup state.

F24.title: Slack subset
F24.rollback: Disable Slack ingress/outbox and revoke connection; retain replay receipts.

F25.title: Discord subset
F25.rollback: Disable Discord ingress/outbox and revoke connection; retain replay receipts.

F26.title: Browser worker
F26.rollback: Close isolated contexts; disable browser tools and egress; remove derived temporary profiles.

F27.title: Computer VM
F27.rollback: Power down disposable VM and revoke transport; never redirect to real host desktop.

F28.title: Sandbox broker
F28.rollback: Deny new execution; cancel/kill workers; no unsandboxed fallback.

F29.title: Sandbox policy
F29.rollback: Revoke image/egress approvals; drain workers; keep text-only operation.

F30.title: Dashboard
F30.rollback: Hide platform panels; retain current chat/logo and API compatibility.

F31.title: Metrics and tracing
F31.rollback: Disable exports/instrumentation; retain current local metrics behavior.

F32.title: Acceptance harness
F32.rollback: Disable release gate only by explicit reviewed policy; keep baseline evidence immutable.

F33.title: Optional packaging
F33.rollback: Use existing base install; uninstall optional extras only after workers drain.

F34.title: Documentation and notices
F34.rollback: Preserve release evidence and attribution; revert code only with compatible documented flags.

F35.title: Optional read-only bridge
F35.rollback: Disable bridge; revoke sidecar credentials; native operation remains independent.
